## Meridian Tidal Pilot - Final Operations Review Summary

**Equipment failure:** Turbine T-4 suffered a multi-week outage after its bearing seal corroded through, allowing seawater into the nacelle. The root cause was traced to corrosion of the bearing seal housing.

**Total energy delivered:** 18.7 GWh over the 24-month operating period, which was 6% below the original forecast of 19.9 GWh.

**Budget outcome:** Final cost reached EUR 41.25 million against an approved budget of EUR 36.7 million — an overrun of EUR 4.55 million (12.4%), driven mainly by the T-4 repair campaign.

**Environmental finding:** Independent fish-monitoring found no statistically significant change in migration counts before and after installation (p = 0.41).

**Recommendation:** Lead engineer Dr. Ines Marchetti recommended replacing the titanium fastener set with duplex stainless steel on all remaining nacelles, which the steering group accepted in principle.

**Final decision:** The steering group approved Phase 2 for Q3 2026, contingent upon a completed redesign of the bearing seal and a successful dry-dock endurance test.
